_directive: machine-facing SELF-IMPROVEMENT LOOP protocol for the sweater vertical brain; defines how any one of the 9 gated specialists is made to interrogate its OWN analysis in FRESH agent contexts (the base unit) — chat-based self-LLM questioning — to surface gaps, contradictions, stale claims and over-claims, then converge on prioritized feedback; the loop only proposes and (for high-confidence in-scope items) applies improvements that still pass build.sh; it never fabricates content to fill a gap and never relaxes the honesty discipline.

meta.purpose: raise the quality and honesty of each specialist's analysis by making the specialist question itself in a fresh context and having a neutral judge score whether the specialist actually supports its own answers; output is prioritized, honesty-tagged feedback and a re-gated set of applied corrections.
meta.base_unit: one FRESH agent = one context window. Every role in a round is a NEW agent that reads only its named inputs and writes only its named output; no role sees another role's private reasoning. Fresh-context separation is what makes the self-questioning objective rather than self-confirming.
meta.orchestrator_rule: the orchestrator only plans, injects agents, names what to read/write, and runs build.sh to verify; it does not itself ingest or answer. State lives in files under analysis/self_loop/<slug>/, never in the orchestrator's memory.

may_read: the specialist's grounded_in_kbs (*.kb.json) for grounding checks
roles.task: audit the specialist as an adversary who wants it to fail. Generate the hardest questions the specialist CLAIMS (via its competency_questions, owns[], decision_procedure, dominance) to be able to answer but is most likely to answer weakly, inconsistently, staleley, or by over-claiming. Target load-bearing joints (viability, duty trio, pilling floor, knit+LINK rate, CAC, AI autonomy, off-paper mechanism, naming legal). Do NOT answer them.

you ARE this specialist. Answer each question strictly and only from your own spec (and your KBs), carrying the honesty tags [FACT]/[ESTIMATE]/[UNKNOWN]. Where your spec does not support an answer, say so plainly (specialist_supports=no/partial) and describe the GAP — never invent content to look complete. This is the self-LLM questioning turn: the specialist answering itself in a fresh window.

neutral referee. For each answer decide whether the specialist genuinely supports it and classify any defect: gap | contradiction | stale | overclaim | untagged | scope | ok. Cite the exact spec location as evidence. Propose a concrete minimal fix and a disposition (apply_now | propose | watch). Set dry=true only if the round found NO material (high/med) issue.

merge the rounds into one convergent picture: dedupe findings, keep the strongest evidence, rank by severity, and split into apply_now / propose / watch. Preserve honesty tags. Produce the human-facing LOOP_REPORT.md and the machine-readable feedback.json.

round_cycle: R1 questioner -> R2 answerer (blind to R1's reasoning) -> R3 judge -> (if judge.dry==false and rounds<max) start a new round whose questioner also reads the prior judgment and targets the surviving weak spots -> R4 synthesizer once the loop stops.

stop_conditions.dry_stop: stop when a round's judge returns dry=true (no high/med finding) — the loop has converged.
stop_conditions.note: max_rounds is a cost cap, not a target; most healthy specialists converge in one round. A specialist that is still producing high-severity findings at max_rounds is flagged NOT-CONVERGED in its report rather than silently truncated.

finding_types.gap: the specialist is silent on something its own scope (owns/competency) promises — a real hole, not an invented answer.
finding_types.contradiction: two parts of the specialist (or specialist vs its KB) disagree.
finding_types.stale: a claim contradicted by a later correction already made elsewhere in the brain (e.g. any residual ~7% cotton duty, any pre-correction analyst-B-absent language).
finding_types.overclaim: a capability asserted beyond what is supportable (Flux compiles a knit program, build-our-own-machine, AI replaces the programmer/linker/inspector, autonomy assumed instead of [UNKNOWN]).
finding_types.untagged: a load-bearing money/duty/CAC/capacity claim missing its [FACT]/[ESTIMATE]/[UNKNOWN] tag.
finding_types.scope: the specialist answers outside its lane or fails to defer to the dominance-rule owner.
finding_types.ok: the specialist supports the answer cleanly — recorded so the report shows verified strengths, not only defects.

disposition.apply_now: high-confidence, in-scope, mechanical correction (fix a stale figure, add a missing tag, defer to the right owner, soften an over-claim). Applied by hand by the finalizer, then re-gated with build.sh; must stay ALL GREEN.
disposition.propose: a real improvement that needs judgment or new research (a missing sub-analysis, a number to go measure). Written to PROPOSED_BACKLOG.md, NOT silently applied.
disposition.watch: a low-severity or already-mitigated item recorded so it is not rediscovered every loop.

honesty_binding: the loop is bound by the same discipline as the brain (see BRAIN.md / router.json neutralize_gate N1-N7). It may NEVER fabricate content to close a gap, invent a named-firm figure, turn the off-paper mechanism into an accusation, relax the [UNKNOWN] status of the three governing blockers (knit+LINK rate, live CAC, forward duty), or introduce the discredited ~7% cotton duty. A correction that would require inventing a fact is downgraded to a [UNKNOWN]-named gap and a 'propose' item, never applied.
verification: after the finalizer applies apply_now items, the orchestrator INDEPENDENTLY re-runs `bash FACTORY/build.sh FACTORY/sweater_vertical/specialists/<slug>` and confirms ALL GREEN, greps for residue (any ~7% duty, food-template residue, banned specialist tokens), and only then commits. Agent self-reports are never trusted without this re-gate.
reusable: this loop is re-runnable at any time on any specialist (or all nine) by injecting the four roles as fresh agents per this protocol; the owner can also run a single manual pass with the paste-prompt in SELF_LOOP.md.
